category: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control (PR.AC-P)
subcategory_text: Identities and credentials are issued, managed, verified, revoked, and audited for authorized individuals, processes, and devices.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: IA-2 (Identification and Authentication), IA-4 (Identifier Management), AC-2 (Account Management)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.16 (Identity management), A.5.17 (Authentication information)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 PR.AA-01 (identities provisioned)
implementation_examples: Issue, manage, verify, revoke, and audit identities and credentials for authorised individuals, processes, and devices that process personal data
Bind credentials to strong authentication mechanisms
Automate provisioning/deprovisioning and capture audit logs
assessment_objectives: Determine whether identities and credentials are issued, managed, and verified for authorised entities
Determine whether credentials are revoked on status change
Determine whether issuance, verification, and revocation events are auditable
Determine whether the credential strength is proportionate to the risk
